saints.antiphon: Christ our Savior, guide us in holiness and faith.
saints.intercession: God of mercy, through the mystery of Christ’s Nativity, strengthen your people in faithful service.
saints.concludingPrayer: Lord God, through the birth of your Son you revealed your love; grant us the grace to follow Him faithfully. Through Christ our Lord.

saints.name: Saint Stephen
saints.shortBiography: Saint Stephen, the first martyr, is honored for his courage, forgiveness, and witness to Christ.
saints.antiphon: Saint Stephen, pray for us, that we may follow Christ in holiness.
saints.intercession: God of mercy, through the witness of Saint Stephen, strengthen your people in faithful service.
saints.concludingPrayer: Lord God, you called Saint Stephen to bear witness to the Gospel; grant us the grace to imitate that holy example. Through Christ our Lord.

saints.name: Saint John, Apostle and Evangelist
saints.shortBiography: Saint John, beloved disciple and evangelist, is honored for his witness to Christ’s divinity and love.
saints.antiphon: Saint John the Apostle, pray for us, that we may follow Christ in holiness.
saints.intercession: God of mercy, through the witness of Saint John the Apostle, strengthen your people in faithful service.
saints.concludingPrayer: Lord God, you called Saint John the Apostle to bear witness to the Gospel; grant us the grace to imitate that holy example. Through Christ our Lord.

saints.name: Holy Innocents
saints.shortBiography: The Holy Innocents are the children martyred by King Herod, honored as witnesses to Christ by their death.
saints.antiphon: Holy Innocents, pray for us, that we may follow Christ in holiness.
saints.intercession: God of mercy, through the witness of the Holy Innocents, strengthen your people in faithful service.
saints.concludingPrayer: Lord God, through the Holy Innocents you revealed the cost of discipleship; grant us the grace to follow Christ faithfully. Through Christ our Lord.
